question: The FIDE World Chess Olympiad 2022 is set to be organised in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is__** India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

Chess Olympiad:

 
• The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi declared open the 44th Chess Olympiad at JLN Indoor Stadium, Chennai.,India
 
• The Prime Minister noted that the 44th Chess Olympiad has been a tournament of many firsts and records.
 
• This is the first time the Chess Olympiad is being held in the place of origin of chess, India. It is coming to Asia for the first time in 3 decades.
 
• The official mascot was named Thambi'. Thambi means 'Hey little brother', which is a common phrase used to address someone.
 
• The horse is the knight in the chess game and the mascot was created to highlight the culture of Tamil Nadu and chess. 
 
• The trophy for the winning team in the open section is the Hamilton-Russell Cup. 
 
• The trophy for the winning team in the women's section is the Vera Menchik Cup.* *
